She has smoked about 6–8 cigarettes daily for the past 10 years and drinks 1–2 glasses of wine
control_chunk_text: on weekends. Current medications include enalapril, metoprolol, and fluoxetine. She is 160 cm (5 ft 6 in) tall and weighs 60 kg (132 lb); BMI is 21.3 kg/m2. Her temperature is 37°C (98.6°F), pulse is 75/min, and blood pressure is 155/85 mm Hg. The lungs are clear to auscultation. Cardiac examination shows no abnormalities. The abdomen is soft and nontender; bowel sounds are normal.
